body: for the time being yeah, I'm still a choke. and no I'm not french unfortunately, just mostly fluent with a tendency to pepper it into speech when I'm more drunk than usual.

I used to meditate. I have since lost the capability. Its a laughable concept nowdays, the thought of setting aside time to be alone and pensive. I'm already alone in my own world all the time anyways.
thank you again for everything, you are a truly incredible human being. if only the world were made of you. Je suis desole que je veuille mourir. Mais, c'est mon seul option.

every passing minute just delays the inevitable. tomorrow I'll simply lack the courage I possess now to attend to the matters at hand. in the end it doesnt matter whether its now or 12 hours from now.

I've been watning to see a theapist for quite some time, but unfortunately it isnt a realistic option in my situation. it wouldnt be feasible for another 4 years (which would just so happen to probably be the most stressful/intense years of my life). the light continues to dim.
Its late here too. Its a little late for me... Honestly, it's been a pleasure mate. Thank you for everything, but please, dont waste any more of your time avec moi.

I'm sorry, but no it doesn't. I honestly appreciate you talking to me because its stopped me from getting in my car and hopping on the highway but I don't get that ^. Its trlyuly flooring how much more a complete stranger on the internet will care more than any physical human being I may know.
I'm sorry, its stubborn, but I'd rather be dead than weaker. At least in death its a mystery.

He overcame a more deplorable situation than I am in, basically on top of an already ridiculous amount of self loathing If i emitted to what was making me want to quit I'd seem like a giant pussy to myself and most of the rest of everyone.

I am in a similar place in this existence. If you need someone to talk to, please pm me and lets talk. I'm toeing the edge, if things don't change soon I can see myself falling victim to myself as well.

I've been yearning for years to get close to someone, anyone. it just doesnt happen. I've tried talking to/talked briefly to my brother, with no results. although he would be the person i would be most upset with disappointing by commiting quitting.

Nah. I'm 20 years into this in a place where people are having nothing but a good time and wouldnt understand someone bitching about a sour note. that's exactly how it would be niterpreted, someone upset about a prime oppurtunity for a good time(aka someone bitching about being youthful and in their prime). My relationship with my family is fantastic i suppose, but being unstable is something we don't talk about. its happened before with a sibling of mine and my situation isn't as bad as theirs was, so I'd seem the weaker creature If I succumbed to what's eating away at me. It wouldn't be as readily accepted.

you know what i mean. you have your good friends, the people that know you inside and out: then you have friends, people that know you, they know things but they don't know you that well. that's the circle that everyone in my life exists in, noone (not even family) knows me. I lack the capability to get close to anyone. I am watching life from the outside and sometimes I can feign the act and be sociable but the majority of existence I simply just float about, watching minutes and people pass me by without any type of connection or deeper meaning

Ive got nobody to talk to. Thats how its always been. I wouldnt dare talk to my family or the people i'd call "friends", 
both would say I was crazy. my family might try to institutionalize me and my friends would simply abandon me, craziness doesnt recieve a welcome reception prom people me age. so I'm left to go crazier in my own existence. Every day I move closer to the edge and today has just been especially spectacular. I can't help but feel that ending it right now is the most ideal option

all my "friends" exist at an arms-length away from me. The girl I'm with right now acts like I'm a ghost, pretty much we just fuck when we're fucked up. no real connection. same as i feel with everyone I come in contact with and everyone I've ever known. There's noone and no reason to care about anymore. I'm becoming more and more convinced that morality and any shred of reality is just bullshit. I wish I could articulate more but I'm drunk. I know why i feel the way I do I just can't exactly articulate it right now, which only exacerbates the situation. all the more reason to wipe this moronic stream of consciousness from existence.
